title: Normalized darts item definition (legacy darts_items domain, patched)
description: Contract for one normalized darts schedule entry: one patched legacy darts_items entry after the targets whole-array replace. The patched integer id is the stable identity, so legacy_id is its decimal form (rule D2); pooled integers are kept verbatim and validated as item references, and start_date is preserved verbatim as a derivation input, never a served value (rules D2/D3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey/census citations.

legacy_id.description: Patched darts_items id preserved verbatim as a string (rule D2): the decimal form of the native integer id.

kind.description: Classification of the patched darts_items domain: every entry maps to darts_item.

source_file.description: Origin file of the patched entry: config/patch/targets.json via the ordered patch layering (stored config/main.json carries the replace inputs).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: patched(targets) — the whole-array replace of /darts_items (rule D1).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes, the patch bytes, and the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Native patched darts id, kept verbatim (rule D2).

start_date.description: Patched start datetime preserved verbatim as a derivation input for make_dynamic; never interpreted as a served value (rule D3).

items.description: Native patched pooled item ids, kept verbatim; every element must resolve against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule D2).

item_refs.description: Resolved cross-domain item references: the pooled ids as legacy_id strings in stored pool order, each validated against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule D2).

extra_item.description: Native patched extra item id, kept verbatim; must resolve against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule D2).

extra_ref.description: Resolved cross-domain item reference for the extra id as a legacy_id string (rule D2).
